figures.finding: Montenegro's Film in Montenegro cash rebate, run by the Film Centre of Montenegro under the Law on Cinematography, returns up to 35% of qualified spend (VAT excluded) on a minimum spend of EUR 100,000, subject to a cultural test of at least 15 points, the request filed at least 15 days before filming. It read 25%, filed a month before filming, from a secondary (ep.com) until 2026-11-04, when the Film Centre's own programme page was read: an error found and fixed.

sources.said: Film in Montenegro offers incentives to international producers in the form of a cash rebate of up to 35% on qualified expenses (excluding the Value Added Tax) … spend a minimum of 100.000 EUR on qualified expenses … score a minimum of 15 points on the cultural test … at least 15 days before the scheduled filming in Montenegro

figures.finding: The Film Centre of Montenegro co-finances domestic films through public calls; it is based in Podgorica.
